    advantages(Rollout, float, float, float) - Static method in class dev.swordai.core.rl.TacticNet
    What each choice in the rollout brought over the critic's expectation, at the half-second scale (generalised advantage estimation over the choices, as for a semi-Markov decision process): for a choice made on step s that stood until step e, A = sum over s<=t<e of gamma^(t-s) delta_t + gamma^(e-s) lambda A_next, with delta_t the critic's own TD error of step t.
